consent.title: Table {number}
consent.lead: Before you start, here is what happens to this recording.
consent.records: This phone records the conversation at your table.
consent.notConfigured: This assembly is not yet set up to transcribe recordings.
consent.noEngine: No transcription engine is configured, so the audio stays on this server.
consent.audioHosted: The recording is sent to {engine}, an outside service, to be turned into text.
consent.audioSelfHosted: The recording is transcribed by {engine} on this organisation's own server. The audio is not sent to any outside company.
consent.transcriptHosted: The written transcript — never the audio — is also sent to an outside AI service to draft a summary.
consent.transcriptSelfHosted: The written transcript is summarised by AI on this organisation's own server.
consent.retentionDays: The audio recording is deleted {days} days after the assembly ends. | The audio recording is deleted one day after the assembly ends. | The audio recording is deleted {days} days after the assembly ends.
consent.retentionForever: The audio recording is kept until an organiser deletes it.
consent.speakers: Speakers are labelled only as “Speaker 1”, “Speaker 2” and so on — the recording is not linked to your identity. Names people say out loud are written down as spoken, so if somebody says your name it will appear in the transcript.
consent.reviewed: Nothing is published until a person has reviewed it.
consent.ask: Please make sure everyone at the table has heard this before you begin.
consent.agree: Everyone at this table agrees — continue
consent.declinedBody: Please tell the facilitator. Nothing has been recorded, and the discussion can still go ahead without this phone.

offline.title: Cannot reach the assembly
offline.body: This table is still joined. Nothing has been lost — any recording on this phone is safe and will upload when the connection returns.

noInvite.title: Table Recorder
noInvite.body: Open this page by scanning your table's QR code.
noInvite.askFacilitator: Ask the facilitator for the QR sheet.

joinError.title: Cannot join
joinError.hint: The QR code may have been revoked. Ask the facilitator for a new one.

mic.failedTitle: The microphone could not be started.
mic.guidance: If the browser asked for microphone permission and it was refused, allow it in the site settings — tap the icon to the left of the web address, then Permissions, then Microphone — and try again. You do not need to reload this page.
mic.blockedBody: Round {position} is open, but this phone could not start its microphone. Check that no other app is using it, and that the browser is allowed to record.
mic.serverHelp: Ask the facilitator — they can hand this table to another phone from the Live tab.

uploaded.title: Recording uploaded
uploaded.body: Round {position} is complete for this table. Every part of the recording was uploaded and accepted, but the server has not finished processing it yet. Keep this phone's copy until it has.

done.title: Recording synchronized
done.body: Round {position} is complete for this table. The recording was uploaded and validated by the server.

armed.allRecordedBody: This table has completed every round. Thank you!
armed.waiting: Waiting for the facilitator to start
armed.waitingHint: Recording begins automatically. Keep this page open and the phone on the table.
armed.offline: Network unavailable — reconnecting… the phone stays armed.

preflight.level: Audio level — speak at the table
preflight.micGuidance: Allow microphone access in the site settings — tap the icon to the left of the web address, then Permissions, then Microphone. You do not need to reload this page.
preflight.noStorage: This browser cannot store audio locally. Recording would not be safe — please use a different browser or disable private mode.
preflight.noRounds: This assembly has no rounds yet.
preflight.recordingElsewhere: This table is already recording on another phone. If that phone has stopped working, ask the facilitator to hand the table to this one.
preflight.title: Microphone test

recording.storageErrorBody: Recording can no longer be safely stored. Please notify the facilitator immediately.
recording.serverBusy: The server is busy — the recording continues safely on this phone and will upload by itself. Nothing is lost. Keep this page open.
recording.offline: Network unavailable — the recording continues safely on this phone and will upload when the connection returns. Keep this page open.
recording.keepOpen: Keep this page open while the table is recording.
recording.lowStorage: Phone storage is getting low. Notify the facilitator after this round.
recording.confirmFinish: Finish and synchronize this table's recording?
recording.retrying: Connection problem or busy server — retrying automatically.
recording.takeABreak: Take a break if you need one — recording starts when you tap the button.
recording.allRounds: This table has completed all rounds
recording.reportPending: Keep this page open — the assembly report appears here when every table has finished or the organizer publishes it.
recording.clearAudio: Clear synchronized audio from this phone
recording.syncFailedSafe: The audio is safely stored on this phone — nothing is lost.
recording.timeUp: Time is up for this round.
recording.finishingIn: Finishing in {seconds} s — tap Keep talking to carry on.
recording.captionsUnavailable: Live captions temporarily unavailable. Recording continues safely.
recording.micLost: The microphone was interrupted — a call or another app took it over. The recording so far was saved and is uploading. Tell the facilitator, then start again when the table is ready.

recovery.intro: This phone has a recording that was not fully synchronized — for example after the page was reloaded or the browser closed. All locally saved audio is intact.
recovery.waiting: Waiting for network… the audio is safe on this phone. Keep this page open.
recovery.done: Recovered recording fully synchronized and validated.
recovery.gone: The server no longer has this recording — the assembly may have been deleted or reset. The audio is still safely stored on this phone.
recovery.confirmDelete: Permanently delete this audio from the phone? This cannot be undone.
recovery.failedHint: Local audio remains stored on this phone. Notify the facilitator.
recovery.title: Recovered recording
recovery.uploaded: Every part of the recording was uploaded and accepted, but the server has not confirmed the assembled audio yet. Keep this phone's copy until it has.

report.mentionedAt: Mentioned at {count} table | Mentioned at {count} table | Mentioned at {count} tables
report.title: Assembly report

purged.title: The recording was removed from this phone
purged.body: The organizer has finished with this assembly, so its audio has been deleted from this device. The server keeps the recording; nothing has been lost.
purged.kept: One recording was NOT deleted, because the server has not confirmed it yet. Please show this phone to the facilitator. | One recording was NOT deleted, because the server has not confirmed it yet. Please show this phone to the facilitator. | {count} recordings were NOT deleted, because the server has not confirmed them yet. Please show this phone to the facilitator.

joining.queued: Lots of tables joining at once — waiting for a turn…

error.network: Nextcloud cannot be reached. Check the connection and try again.
error.permission: You do not have permission to do that.
error.notFound: That no longer exists — it may have been deleted.
error.tooLarge: That file is too large to upload.
error.busy: The server is busy. Try again in a moment.
error.server: The server had a problem. Nothing was changed — try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again, or reload the page.
